built: 2026-11-12 (MT) cursor/phone-cat-space-2026-11-12: phone top bar reserves space for the 44px cat (tune --subx-cat-space, default 52px) and the cat has a light drop-shadow outline so it reads on a dark banner; v1.2.10 blocked Google popup and preload unchanged

factory-gp.js.loadWhen: site.json features.watchlist|topicFollow|sessionSeeds true, or rail.kind f1-calendar (gpchat only today)

factory-rail.js.loadWhen: site.json rail.kind nws-forecast|nws-cwf|bart-bsa, or rail.forecastUrl / rail.lat+lon (415, 808, samo, bart)

factory-reports.js.loadWhen: site.json features.reportLoop true (A9 report loop; airlineschat/amachat first once unkilled)

factory-signin.js.loadWhen: lazy, prefetched at factory boot so a Google tap can call signInWithPopup in the same gesture; also handles redirect result, email, register, email-already-in-use, forgot password, and the join-sheet layout, and the in-app-browser Open in your browser note
